summary: Join our Property Law and Title Examination Training Course to develop critical skills and knowledge for navigating the complexities of real estate law.
lede: Property law and title examination helps property, finance, legal, and project professionals assess ownership and title risks in transactions. It covers interpreting titles, deeds, and land records; verifying ownership and encumbrances; comparing documents with survey plans; spotting fraud risks; and communicating findings to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly interact with land and property decisions and need to understand property law and title risk.
audience: In-house legal counsel and compliance officers
Real estate developers and project managers
Valuers, surveyors, and due diligence consultants
modules: Foundations of Property Law and Land Rights
Practical Title Examination and Due Diligence
Property Transactions: Sales, Leases, and Mortgages
Public Sector and NGO Land Issues
Survey Plans, Boundaries, and Land Use Controls
Fraud, Forgery, and Red Flags in Property Deals
Dispute Prevention, Resolution, and Risk Management
Communicating Findings and Advising Decision Makers
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of property transactions or related experience in real estate, finance, or legal roles.
